title: You Don't Need Thousands to Start Investing
hook_text: WAIT UNTIL YOU HEAR THIS NUMBER

beats.say: You think investing takes thousands of dollars. It doesn't.
beats.visual: Close-up of a hand dropping a single coin onto a dark wooden table, cinematic side lighting, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: In fact, starting with just $100 a month changes everything.
beats.visual: A minimalist white desk with a brass lamp, single coffee cup, out of focus background, moody morning light.

beats.say: Stay with me, because the math gets wild after year 10.
beats.visual: An open window showing a quiet rainy street at dusk, cinematic blue hour tones, empty interior.

beats.say: If you put $100 a month into the market at 8% a year...
beats.visual: A simple black leather notebook lying closed on a concrete surface, sharp shadows, high contrast.
A vintage mechanical desk clock ticking on a dark shelf, soft warm tungsten glow, cinematic grain.

beats.say: Out of that total, you only put in $48,000 of your own cash.
beats.visual: A neat stack of plain white envelopes on a rustic wood table, viewed from above, moody cinematic lighting.

beats.say: But here's the part nobody mentions about starting early.
beats.visual: A single train track stretching out into a foggy horizon, symmetrical framing, moody grey daylight.

beats.say: If you wait just 10 years to start, the gap is massive.
beats.visual: An empty subway platform with warm overhead lights reflecting off polished concrete floors.

beats.say: At 8% until age 65, starting at 25 gives you $698,202.
beats.visual: A calendar page flipping in slow motion, backlit by soft afternoon sun, deep shadows.

beats.say: Starting at 35 drops that final number to $298,072.
beats.visual: A closed minimalist door with a single stream of bright sunlight cutting across the floor.

beats.say: That 10-year delay costs you $400,130 in missed growth.
beats.visual: A pair of keys resting on an empty entryway table, dramatic overhead shadows, cinematic noir style.

beats.say: So stop waiting for a big paycheck because that's exactly how
beats.visual: A hand sliding a blank white card across a dark marble surface, sharp focus, moody atmosphere.

beats.say: you think investing takes thousands of dollars.
beats.visual: A dark coffee mug sitting next to an unread book, soft morning light filtering through blinds, loop ending.

caption: Small amounts compound quietly in the background while you live your life. #investing #moneytips #personalfinance #wealthbuilding #quietmoney
description: The math behind starting small with investing. Why waiting for a large lump sum costs you hundreds of thousands of dollars over time.
first_comment: What's stopping you from investing your first $100 this month?
